mesh_read_off — FILEIO mesh op

• Data kinds: text → mesh

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.mesh_read_off(data) (to call the implementation directly, import fileio; fileio.mesh_read_off(data); from the registry, opsfileio.get("mesh_read_off"))

Usage

Read Geomview OFF and return a triangle mesh (vertices, faces).

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

宣言した頂点・面数とデータ行数、全添字を検査する。呼び出し例: mesh = mesh_read_off(off_text)。
